```{r}
set.seed(42)
library(keras)
library(abind)
w3_data <- abind(amecro, barswa, bkcchi, blujay, daejun, houfin, mallar3, norfli, rewbla, stejay, wesmea, whcspa, along =1)
dim(w3_data)

# Combine the spectrograms into one matrix
x <- abind(blujay, stejay, along = 1)
y <- c(rep('blujay', dim(blujay)[1]), rep('stejay', dim(stejay)[1]))

# length(y)
# Create the target variable (labels)

x <- array_reshape(x, c(nrow(x), 87808))
y_factor <- factor(y, levels = c('blujay', 'stejay'))
#length(y_factor)
y_encode <- to_categorical(as.integer(y_factor) - 1, num_classes = 2)
#length(y_encode)


# Split the data into training and testing sets
n <- nrow(x)
train_measure <- sample(n, floor(0.8*n))

x_train <- x[train_measure,]
y_train <-  y_encode[train_measure, ]
x_test <- x[-train_measure,]
y_test <- y_encode[-train_measure,]


# Define the model
# model <- keras_model_sequential()
# model %>%
#   layer_dense(units = 64, activation = "relu", input_shape = c(87808)) %>%
#   layer_dropout(rate = 0.5) %>%
#   layer_dense(units = 32, activation = "relu") %>%
#   layer_dropout(rate = 0.5) %>%
#   layer_dense(units = 2, activation = "softmax")  # Output layer with softmax activation for binary classification #this model took less than 30 seconds to run

# > cat("Test loss:", metrics[[1]], "\n")
# Test loss: 0.2810534 
# > cat("Test accuracy:", metrics[[2]], "\n")
# Test accuracy: 0.8888889 

# > cat("Test loss:", metrics[[1]], "\n")
# Test loss: 0.2052964 
# > cat("Test accuracy:", metrics[[2]], "\n")
# Test accuracy: 0.9444444 

model <- keras_model_sequential()
model %>%
  layer_dense(units = 128, activation = "relu", input_shape = c(87808)) %>%
  layer_dropout(rate = 0.5) %>%
  layer_dense(units = 64, activation = "relu") %>%
  layer_dropout(rate = 0.5) %>%
  layer_dense(units = 32, activation = "relu") %>%
  layer_dropout(rate = 0.5) %>%
  layer_dense(units = 2, activation = "softmax")  # Output layer with softmax activation for binary classification

# > cat("Test loss:", metrics[[1]], "\n")
# Test loss: 0.3542859 
# > cat("Test accuracy:", metrics[[2]], "\n")
# Test accuracy: 0.7222222 also took less than 30 seconds to run

# > cat("Test loss:", metrics[[1]], "\n")
# Test loss: 0.5489867 
# > cat("Test accuracy:", metrics[[2]], "\n")
# Test accuracy: 0.8888889 



# Compile the model
model %>% compile(
  loss = "categorical_crossentropy",
  optimizer = "adam",
  metrics = c("accuracy")
)

# Train the model
model %>% fit(
  x = x_train,
  y = y_train,
  epochs = 10,
  batch_size = 32,
  validation_data = list(x_test, y_test)
)

# Evaluate the model
metrics <- model %>% evaluate(x_test, y_test)
cat("Test loss:", metrics[[1]], "\n")
cat("Test accuracy:", metrics[[2]], "\n")

```


classification for all 12 species


```{r}
# Example variables to encode
variables <- c("var1", "var2", "var3", "var4", "var5", "var6", "var7", "var8", "var9", "var10", "var11", "var12")

# Example labels (numeric)
labels <- c("amecro", "barswa", "bkcchi", "blujay", "daejun", "houfin", "mallar3", "norfli", "rewbla", "stejay", "wesmea", "whcspa")

# Create a data frame with the variables
data <- data.frame(var1 = c(1, 2, 3),
                   var2 = c(1, 3, 2),
                   var3 = c(2, 1, 3),
                   var4 = c(3, 2, 1),
                   var5 = c(2, 3, 1),
                   var6 = c(3, 1, 2),
                   var7 = c(1, 2, 3),
                   var8 = c(2, 3, 1),
                   var9 = c(3, 1, 2),
                   var10 = c(1, 2, 3),
                   var11 = c(2, 3, 1),
                   var12 = c(3, 1, 2))

# One-hot encode the variables
encoded_data <- model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = data)

# Rename the encoded columns with labels
colnames(encoded_data) <- labels

# View the encoded data
print(encoded_data)

```

```{r}
# Combine the spectrograms into a single array
spectrograms <- array(0, dim = c(594, 343, 256))
spectrograms[1:52,,] <- amecro
spectrograms[53:107,,] <- barswa
spectrograms[108:164,,] <- bkcchi
spectrograms[165:214,,] <- blujay
spectrograms[215:272,,] <- daejun
spectrograms[273:317,,] <- houfin
spectrograms[318:353,,] <- mallar3
spectrograms[354:412,,] <- norfli
spectrograms[413:453,,] <- rewbla
spectrograms[454:493,,] <- stejay
spectrograms[494:529,,] <- wesmea
spectrograms[530:580,,] <- whcspa

# Label the data
labels <- c(rep("amecro", 52), rep("barswa", 55), rep("bkcchi", 57), rep("blujay", 50),
            rep("daejun", 58), rep("houfin", 45), rep("mallar3", 36), rep("norfli", 59),
            rep("rewbla", 41), rep("stejay", 40), rep("wesmea", 36), rep("whcspa", 51))

# Shuffle the data and labels
index <- sample(1:length(labels))
spectrograms <- spectrograms[index,,]
labels <- labels[index]

# Create a training and testing set
train_size <- round(length(labels) * 0.7)
train_data <- spectrograms[1:train_size,,]
train_labels <- labels[1:train_size]
test_data <- spectrograms[(train_size+1):length(labels),,]
test_labels <- labels[(train_size+1):length(labels)]

dim(train_data)
dim(test_data)

# reshape the data
train_data <- array_reshape(train_data, c(train_size, 343, 256, 1))
test_data <- array_reshape(test_data, c(length(labels) - train_size, 343, 256, 1))

# one hot encode the labels
# train_labels <- one_hot(train_labels, 12)
# test_labels <- one_hot(test_labels, 12)

# Convert labels to numerical categories
label_categories <- factor(labels)
label_categories <- as.integer(label_categories) - 1

# One-hot encode the labels using to_categorical
train_labels <- to_categorical(label_categories[1:train_size], num_classes = 12)
test_labels <- to_categorical(label_categories[(train_size+1):length(labels)], num_classes = 12)

dim(train_data)
dim(test_data)
```

```{r}
library(keras)

# Define the model architecture

model <- keras_model_sequential() %>%
  layer_conv_2d(filters = 32, kernel_size = c(3, 3), activation = "relu", input_shape = c(343, 256, 1)) %>%
  layer_max_pooling_2d(pool_size = c(2, 2)) %>%
  layer_flatten() %>%
  layer_dense(units = 64, activation = "relu") %>%
  layer_dropout(rate = 0.5) %>%
  layer_dense(units = 12, activation = "softmax") #7 min run and Test accuracy: 0.6436782
```
